title: UnderWorldSettings
description: Configuration for running the UnderworldGodot project.

pathuw1.description: Folder location of the Underworld 1 game files.

pathuw2.description: Folder location of the Underworld 2 game files.

gametoload.description: Which of the two games to load.

level.description: The game level to load. (0-8 in UW1, 0-71 in UW2)

lightlevel.description: Set the lighting level of the dungeon. Value is ignored.

shader.description: Default shader used. Value is ignored. (was previously used to allow for selection of different shaders during experimentation of palette effects)

showcolliders.description: Enables displaying of collision meshes and colliders in game

shaderbandsize.description: Controls how many light shades are calculated in between the vanilla shades.dat colour palette values to smooth light shading. (no of interpolated colours between the vanilla colours)

synth.description: Music synthesizer engine. 'cm32l' and 'mt32' use mt32emu (require ROM files). 'soundfont' uses a SoundFont (SF2) file. 'opl' uses AdLib/OPL FM synthesis.

synthpath.description: Path to the .sf2 file for soundfont. Empty = use defaults.

rompath.description: Folder of the MT-32 or CM-32L ROM images for cm32l/mt32. Empty = ROMS beside the program (the project folder when run from source).

hdartpath.description: Folder of higher resolution indexed textures and critter frames (uw1/ and uw2/ subfolders of .uwhd files). Empty = original art.

hdartroot.description: Folder holding the art sets the launcher's Art option lists (each set a subfolder with uw1/ and uw2/). Empty = the folder hdartpath is in.

language.description: Language of the game text: "en", or one with a translation under i18npath or the project's i18n folder (uw1/<language>/master.tsv). Only UW1 has one (zh-TW).

i18npath.description: Folder holding translations (uw1/<language>/master.tsv) and the font they need (fonts/jf-openhuninn-2.1.ttf). Empty = the project's i18n folder.

resolution.description: Window size as WIDTHxHEIGHT (shrunk to fit the screen, keeping its shape), or "fullscreen". The game draws at 1280x800 and is scaled to the window.

controls.description: "classic", the original's controls, or "modern": with no interaction icon selected a left click talks, picks up or uses by what it is on and a right click looks, shift + click puts what is picked up in the backpack, the mouse look key turns the view with the mouse, the weapon key draws the weapon (left button swings), the wheel steps through the icons, and the keys below.

mousesensitivity.description: Mouse look speed under modern controls, 1 to 10.

invertmouse.description: Under modern controls' mouse look, moving the mouse up looks down.

keys.description: Modern controls' keys that differ from the defaults, by action (Forward, Back, StrafeLeft, StrafeRight, TurnLeft, TurnRight, Jump, FlyUp, FlyDown, LookDown, LookUp, LookCentre, MouseLook, Weapon, Bash, Slash, Stab), as Godot names keys ("W", "Space", "Tab").
